responsibility: Defines the backend-facing trait surface that backend-agnostic SSA code generation relies on, tying together the full contract for a codegen backend: top-level backend lifecycle and output stages; predeclaration of functions and statics; construction of backend types and constants; creation and reference of static storage; miscellaneous codegen-context services; the per-function builder interface for emitting IR; builder hooks for reading incoming ABI arguments, lowering intrinsics, assembly, coverage instrumentation, and debug info; and the module hub that re-exports these pieces and assembles them into composite backend and builder capability traits used throughout rustc_codegen_ssa.
